newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open-market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open-market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York refrained from intervening in the open market on Friday, according to dealers.
At 1130 EDT/1530 GMT, the Fed's usual intervention time, federal funds changed hands at 5-1/4 percent, the Fed target.
The Fed injected reserves on Thursday with six-day fixed system repurchase agreements to meet a large add need around the U.S. Labor Day holiday on Monday.
U.S. markets will be closed on Monday. Trading will resume on Tuesday.
